title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Waste Management - WasteContainer
description: A street waste container, e.g. for glass, plastics/metals/cartons, or general waste (edintwaste:WasteContainer, subclass of edintwaste:WasteFacility, edint-infraestructura's Facility).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WasteContainer'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

address.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/address'. The mailing address (reusing esdir:DireccionPostal). Inherited from WasteFacility.

belongsTo.description: Relationship. Territorial unit(s) (Barrio, Distrito or Municipio) this facility belongs to (edintwaste:belongsTo). Modeled as an array since the source's own real example data shows a WasteContainer belonging to both a Barrio and a Distrito simultaneously. Inherited from WasteFacility.

acceptsWasteType.description: Property. Waste type(s) accepted by this container, from the WasteType controlled vocabulary (edintwaste:acceptsWasteType).

model.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/model'. The container's model, e.g. 'E 3100 CS'.

containerBatch.description: Property. Batch number of the container (edintwaste:containerBatch).

containerLocationCode.description: Property. Internal code identifying the container's location (edintwaste:containerLocationCode).

containerType.description: Property. Type of container (edintwaste:containerType). The source ontology does not constrain this to a controlled vocabulary.

loadingType.description: Property. How the container is loaded, e.g. 'Carga superior' (top-loading) (edintwaste:loadingType). The source ontology does not constrain this to a controlled vocabulary.

order.description: Property. Ordinal/reference number of the container (edintwaste:order).
